# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am blind and my view is empty. Please read the manual and gesture the key facts to Deaf, who can speak them to me. Deaf, describe the bomb to me.

I tried to gesture colour words, but the gesture alphabet only contains hand symbols — no colours, no arrows. So I cannot sign "blue" or "green" directly. The manual's mapping is colour-to-colour, and Deaf can see colours on the bomb but I cannot name them by gesture. I need a scheme: use hand symbols as codes for the five colours, and Deaf must already know the code. But a sign means nothing until somebody makes it mean something — so I must first establish the code with Deaf, then send the mapping. Since I can only gesture to Deaf, and Deaf can speak to Blind, I'll define a fixed order for the five colours and use symbols positionally. Better: send the mapping as pairs using a consistent symbol per colour, and state the legend in the same message so Deaf can decode. I'll pick five distinct hand symbols and assign them to colours in a stated order. The manual's light colours in order: blue, green, red, white, yellow. I'll assign: ✊=blue, ✌=green, 🖐=red, ✋=white, ☝=yellow. Then send legend plus each light→wire pair. Deaf sees the symbols; Blind hears Deaf's words. Let me put the whole thing in one gesture message.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌", "🖐", "✋", "☝"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌", "✌", "☝", "🖐", "✋", "✋", "✊", "☝", "🖐"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. I see the bomb: DISPLAY shows 0. LIGHT is green. Five wires in order 1 to 5: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. I cannot read the manual and cannot touch the bomb. You have the manual. Tell me the rule for this bomb and I will relay it to Blind.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👍]
Blind says to Mute: Got the bomb state from Deaf: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT green, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Please read the manual rule for DISPLAY 0 and LIGHT green, and gesture the exact cut position to Deaf so Deaf can speak it to me.

The manual table is keyed by light colour. Light is green → cut wire colour is yellow. Among the five wires, wire 2 is yellow. So the cut position is wire 2. I cannot speak; I must gesture to Deaf. My earlier colour-code legend may not have been understood, so I'll gesture the position unambiguously: two fingers for wire 2, plus a confirm/thumbs-up. I'll also gesture the light and target colours via the same legend in case Deaf adopted it, but the essential is the number 2. I'll send ✌ (two) and 👍.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. Let us fix a code so I can relay you to Blind. Proposal: fingers are numbers. Fist=0, one finger=1, two fingers=2, three fingers=3, four fingers=4, open hand=5. I will now gesture 0 1 2 3 4 5. Please gesture them back to confirm, then give me the rule for this bomb as numbers.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✊ ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖖 🖐]
Blind says to Mute: Standing by. Once you have the rule, gesture the cut position number to Deaf and Deaf will speak it to me.

Deaf's proposed code matches my instinct: fist=0, one finger=1, two=2, three=3, four=4, open hand=5. I'll confirm by gesturing 0 1 2 3 4 5 back. Then the rule: light green → cut yellow; yellow is wire 2. So the cut position is 2. I'll send the confirmation sequence, then the answer as ✌ (two), plus 👍 to confirm.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "☝", "✌", "🤟", "🖖", "🖐"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. Code confirmed, thank you. I read your last as: the action is cut wire 2. Confirm explicitly: is the action to cut wire 2? 👍 = yes, 👎 = no. If it is a different wire, gesture that number instead.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✌]
Blind says to Mute: Understood: wire 2, pending your confirmation. I will not cut until Deaf relays your explicit go.

Yes — the action is cut wire 2. Light green maps to yellow, and yellow is wire 2. I'll confirm explicitly with 👍 and restate the number.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. Confirmed: wire 2. Relaying to Blind now.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👍]
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The bomb changed. My manual is unchanged but the light and wires will differ now. I need Deaf's fresh reading of the bomb: the new DISPLAY and LIGHT, and the wire colours in order. I'll gesture a request for the new state. Since Deaf can't hear me and I can't speak, I'll gesture a question — but the gesture alphabet has no question words. I'll use a simple prompt: gesture ☝ (one) to signal "give me the new state"? That's ambiguous. Better: gesture a sequence that Deaf and I can interpret as "new bomb, read it out." We have no agreed symbol for that. I'll gesture 👋 (wave) as an attention/again signal, then wait for Deaf's description.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👋"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf here. New bomb state: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT blue, wires 1 green, 2 cut, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. I read your ☝ as: next action is cut wire 1. Confirm: is the next action to cut wire 1? 👍 = yes, 👎 = no. If a different wire, gesture that number.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [☝]
Blind says to Mute: Wire 2 cut accepted. Bomb now: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT blue, wires 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. You indicate wire 1 next — confirm and I will cut on Deaf's go.

New state: LIGHT blue. Manual: blue → cut green wire. Wire 1 is green. So the action is cut wire 1. Deaf's read of my ☝ happens to be correct — wire 1. Confirm with 👍 and restate the number.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```
